name: Air Fryer Steak Fajitas with Tortillas and Guacamole

components.name: Steak & Fajita Vegetables

ingredients.name: Raw trimmed flank steak sliced thinly across grain
Raw red and green bell peppers, thin strips

steps: Slice steak across the grain into even strips. Mix steak with 20 ml oil, chili-lime seasoning, cumin, coriander, pepper and salt; refrigerate 20-30 minutes.
Slice peppers and onions. Toss vegetables with 15 ml oil and 20 ml lime juice.
Preheat air fryer to approximately 195 C. Spread vegetables in one layer, air fry about 6-9 minutes, shaking. Transfer out before they soften fully.
Cook steak strips in two or more air-fryer batches for around 6-10 minutes until desired doneness. Check doneness using a probe; do not stack raw meat thickly.
Freeze cooked steak and pepper mixture if necessary; fresh avocado and tortillas should be packed separately. Reheat meat gently to avoid dryness.

components.name: Tortillas, Guacamole & Salsa

ingredients.name: Eight flour tortillas at 40 g each

steps: Mash avocado with its lime juice and coriander. Portion steak, peppers and onions with two flour tortillas per serving; keep guacamole, tortillas and salsa separate until eating.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Based on Whirlpool air-fryer flank steak fajitas; full quantified guacamole and tortillas are UNHANGRY additions/adjustments.
Planning: Vegetables and steak need several air-fryer loads; pack avocado fresh on serving day.
Freezer: cooked fajita meat and peppers freeze; guacamole browns and separates
Dietary: Wheat in tortillas. No pork.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
